IDBI Bank Privatization Deal with Fairfax Financial Under Scrutiny

The Indian government is preparing to sell a controlling stake in IDBI Bank to the Canadian company Fairfax Financial for approximately ₹52,878 crore. This move has sparked controversy, particularly as the bank has recently transitioned from a loss-making entity to a profitable one. The deal involves the government and Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) selling their stakes.
